$comment: Hungarian typography: „…” primary (macOS Finder: „^0”, „%@”), »…« nested (the AkH nested pair, one of macOS NSSpellChecker's quote styles), ’ for the rare apostrophe. Hungarian writes % tight against the number and no space before ! ? : ;. Hedges: every form that hangs on the first sound or the vowels of a value Cmdr doesn't know. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: Hungarian writes % tight against the number (42%)

hedges.why: the a(z) article hedge; name the object's type first (ezt a fájlt: „{name}”), use a colon slot (itt: {path}), or drop the article in a label
a bracketed ending (fájl(ok), (e)t); counted nouns stay singular, so use ICU plural or rephrase
a slashed suffix pair (-ban/-ben); vowel harmony can't be guessed, so rephrase
a case suffix on an insert ({path}-ban, „{name}”-et) hangs on sounds Cmdr can't know; use a colon slot, a postposition, or a base noun that carries the suffix
a guessed a/az before a quoted insert (a code span reads as an insert too, so only the quoted form is checked); the article follows the value's first sound, so name the type first or use a colon slot
